from: September book, night 13 (A Time for Everything)
p1: The Preacher was a son of King David and a king in Jerusalem. He wrote a book of wise sayings called Ecclesiastes.
He wrote, “To every thing there is a season.” There is a right time for everything.
Farmers knew this well. There was a time to plant seeds, and a time to pick the food.
p2: There is “a time to laugh” and “a time to dance.” There is a time to hug and a time to be quiet. The Preacher said Heavenly Father “made every thing beautiful in his time.”
Now it is a time to rest. Lie still and cozy. Heavenly Father made this sleepy time beautiful too.
old: A wise teacher once wrote a thoughtful book called Ecclesiastes. In it, he shared a gentle truth: there is a right time for everything.
“There’s a time to plant seeds and a time to pick the fruit,” he said. “A time to laugh and a time to cry. A time to hug and a time to rest.”
Heavenly Father made the world with seasons and times. Winter comes, then spring. Morning comes, then night. Everything has its own special time.
Some days are for playing and giggling. Some days are for resting and being quiet. Some feelings come and go, and that’s okay — each one has its time.
Heavenly Father is with us in every season and every time. We can trust Him whether we’re laughing or crying, busy or still. He holds all our times in His loving hands.
